hypotheses: Hfeature: low-dimensional input summaries or frozen embeddings improve relative-error q90 beyond lifetime
Hneighbour: a fixed curve neighbourhood estimates the error tail better than lifetime-only without a learned risk scalar
data: original train97 OOF and original dev20 only; original cal/test excluded
kernel_bandwidth_rule: 0.5*median positive reference pairwise distance; no tuning

feature_families.embedding: fold-specific frozen encoder; no pooling coordinate systems
feature_families.curve: 57 time features, six balanced blocks for distances

validation: OOF leave auxiliary fold out (screen only; overlapping reference OOF fits); dev20 repeated five frozen-model views
decision: OOF gain>=2% and >=3/5 fold wins vs matched life-only; positive dev gain and >=3/5 view wins; exploratory candidates only
plots: all97 primary OOF queries; no outcome-based page selection
